title: V2 rocket goes off course into Mexico as a warning

tellings.quote: Next thing you know, a V2 rocket goes off course and hits a a place in Mexico.

plain: In the late 1940s, a V2 rocket, the German missile of World War II, went off course and came down somewhere in Mexico, and the researcher Jason Jorjani presents this as a warning sent to someone. Jorjani tells it to Michels in passing, without naming a source: "next thing you know, a V2 rocket goes off course and hits a place in Mexico." If he is right, a rocket crash written off as an accident was really a message in a hidden contest over German rocket know-how.
